model_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-29 (timely filing) on a commercial plan (CI). DOS 2024-07-13; 277CA shows the claim was accepted (STC*A2:20) on 2024-07-18 — 5 days post-DOS, well within any commercial filing limit. The payer's CO-29 is disputable with proof of timely receipt.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 but 277CA proves claim accepted 2024-07-18, only 5 days after DOS 2024-07-13. Filing was timely; denial is incorrect.

next_action.detail: Appeal all three lines with the 277CA acceptance report (2024-07-18, STC A2:20) as proof of timely filing. Dispute the payer's receipt-date determination.

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report: dispute the receipt date
